source_review.notes: Checked all six references for identity, date or current-document status, and support for nearby claims. Google SRE supports service-specific production-readiness analysis, improvements, training and ownership transfer, plus tailored launch coverage of architecture, dependencies, capacity, failure, monitoring, security, automation and rollout.
